name: Herbalism Scholar Study
body:
Prerequisite(s): Green Thumb study ability, scholar level 2nd.

If you spend one hour gathering natural herbs, you can mix a potion-like concoction in 1 minute. (You can gather these ingredients in 10 minutes if you have the favored terrain class feature and are in one of your favored terrains.) The ingredients can be kept fresh for up to 24 hours. Mixing the concoction also expends 1 point of inspiration. It emulates the effects of a 18 polypurpose panacea or remove sickness spell (your choice). Once you reach 5th level, you can instead mix an herbal concoction that mimics delay disease, delay poison, or remove paralysis.

Once you reach 8th level, you can instead mix an herbal concoction that mimics neutralize poison, remove disease, or remove blindness/deafness. You can gather herbs for multiple concoctions at once, although they must be mixed separately. You may mix a maximum number of herbal concoctions per day equal to 1 + 1 for every 5 ranks you possess in Knowledge (nature). Your concoctions lose their potency if not drunk within 1 minute of mixing, and thus cannot be sold.

Plant Companion (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Green Thumb study ability, Knowledge (nature) 4 ranks, scholar level 4th.

You gain a plant companion, as the treesinger druid archetype. You use your ranks in Knowledge (nature) –3 as your effective druid level to determine the abilities of your plant companion.
